product_overview: TAC Cargo is an enterprise-grade logistics and freight management platform focusing on the Imphal–Delhi corridor. It provides real-time shipment tracking, comprehensive shipment lifecycle management, detailed operational dashboards, fleet and customer management features, and integrates with advanced AI protocols for enhanced logistics operations.
core_goals: Enable real-time and accurate shipment tracking with detailed status updates and timeline visualizations.
Provide a centralized dashboard for key performance indicators including shipment analytics, revenue metrics, and transit statistics.
Ensure secure access through Supabase-based authentication with role-based permissions and session management.
Manage complete shipment lifecycle including creation, updates, exception handling, and invoice generation.
Support warehouse and inventory management with barcode scanning and comprehensive cargo manifest management.
Deliver a seamless and responsive user experience with a robust design system adhering to accessibility and performance standards.
key_features: Dashboard Overview displaying shipment statuses, KPIs, revenue metrics, and operational analytics with real-time updates.
Complete Shipment Management system supporting search, filter, CRUD operations, and status tracking.
AWB-based Real-time Shipment Tracking with timeline visualization, location history, and status updates.
Barcode Scanning system with GS1 validation for warehouse operations and shipment verification.
Invoice Management supporting generation, PDF exports, and billing workflows.
Customer and Manifest Management modules for customer data and bulk shipment processing.
Inventory Tracking for warehouses integrated with shipment data and scanning features.
Payment Processing monitoring financial transactions related to shipments.
Supabase-based Authentication with server-side session management and role-based access controls.
Responsive Navigation and Layout components including sidebar, header, and theme toggle supporting dark and light modes.
Integration of Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI tools and automation interface.
Global error handling with Sentry integration for monitoring and error boundary components.
Strict adherence to semantic design tokens with OKLCH color space and Tailwind CSS v4 for consistent styling and accessibility.
user_flow_summary: User visits landing page to learn about TAC Cargo services and features.
User signs in via email/password authentication; the system validates and sets secure sessions.
Authenticated users access the dashboard showing shipment stats, KPI cards, and operational widgets.
Users navigate to shipment management to create, update, or track shipments using filters and search.
In the shipment tracking UI, users input AWB or tracking ID to view real-time status, location timeline, and delivery estimations.
Warehouse staff perform barcode scanning with GS1 validation to verify cargo and manage inventory.
Users generate invoices and export billing documents in PDF format from the invoice management section.
Administrators or authorized roles manage customer data, shipment manifests, and handle exceptions like delays or damages.
All user actions involving data mutations invoke Server Actions with input validation and trigger cache revalidation for instant UI updates.
Users toggle between dark and light themes, maintaining accessibility and visual consistency across devices.
validation_criteria: All pages render within sub-2 second load times under normal network conditions.
System uptime meets or exceeds 99.5% SLA with minimal downtime.
Authentication is enforced for all protected routes and APIs, preventing unauthorized access.
All user input is validated client-side and server-side using Zod schemas to prevent invalid data and injection attacks.
UI elements use only semantic color tokens with no hardcoded colors, adhering to the OKLCH color format and project design system.
Accessibility standards meet WCAG AA requirements including keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes for interactive elements.
Real-time tracking updates reflect within stipulated intervals (e.g., 30 seconds) and sync correctly without duplication.
Server Actions process mutations correctly and trigger necessary cache invalidations and UI updates.
Error boundaries and centralized Sentry monitoring capture and report runtime errors effectively.
API responses conform to the standardized structure with appropriate HTTP status codes and error formats.
Bundle sizes per route do not exceed set limits to ensure optimal performance.
Secure cookie and session handling is verified through middleware and session management utilities.
Test coverage includes unit tests for critical utilities, component tests for UI primitives, and integration tests for core workflows.
